main.description: A minimal public event occurrence: name, time and an optional venue reference. Independently authored; not copied from any Subcults source. Never tickets, contacts, staffing, settlement or private location detail.

profile.description: Strong reference to the tv.subcult.profile record of the creator or collective who authored this occurrence.

place.description: Strong reference to the tv.subcult.place record for this occurrence's venue. Absent when the occurrence has no public venue.

startsAt.description: RFC 3339 instant when the occurrence starts, with an explicit UTC offset. A public occurrence always has a known, public start time; an occurrence whose time is still to-be-announced is kept as a private draft and is not represented by this record.

endsAt.description: RFC 3339 instant when the occurrence ends, with an explicit UTC offset.

allDay.description: True when the occurrence spans whole local calendar day(s) rather than a specific clock time. When true, startsAt/endsAt carry the UTC instants of local-midnight day boundaries and timezone identifies the local calendar.

timezone.description: IANA time zone database identifier (for example 'America/Chicago') giving the local wall-clock zone for startsAt/endsAt. Present whenever a local wall time, rather than only the UTC instant, matters to attendees.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant when the occurrence record was created.

strongRef.description: A self-contained strong reference to another admitted public record: an AT-URI and the CID observed at reference time. Kept local to this Lexicon so the admitted chain does not depend on unbundled base schemas.

cid.description: CID of the referenced record at reference time.
